BiblicalUsage: Job curses the day of his birth and asks that no daylight shine upon it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Job's curse is the cry of a man who cannot see past his pain: he asks the light not to shine, and God lets him ask, because the God who made the daylight can bear the question.
